Review Record Rules for a User

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to open the record rules that apply to a user and read which records that person is allowed to see.

1. Open Settings

Open the Settings app.

2. Users & Companies

Open the Users & Companies menu.

3. Users

Click Users.

4. Open a user

Click a user to open the record.

5. Record Rules

Click Record Rules to see the rules that apply to this user.

6. Open the rule

Click a rule to open it.

7. Domain

Read the domain. Click inside the form to continue.
